title: hieracium leiocephalum subsp. timaviense
intro: Hieracium leiocephalum subsp. timaviense, commonly known as a member of the dandelion family, is a plant species. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium leiocephalum subsp. timaviense include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although more research is needed to fully understand its properties and effects.
